tbesh_html:
1) to be ashamed, be confounded, be abashed, feel abashed
1a) (Qal) to be ashamed, be abashed
1b) (Hiphil) to display shame, demonstrate shame, cause embarrassment

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as H2658 (חָפַר) through the idea of detection);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.
